chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, from Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, from ʿAli عليه السلام.
He said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “There is no preemption in a ship, nor in a river, nor in a road, nor in a mill, nor in a bathhouse.”

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakuni; the named narrator in the chain
key_terms.شُفْعَةَ: preemption; the legal right to take over a sold share before another buyer

ai.seo_question: In which types of property is the right of shufʿah not applicable in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning shufʿah, stating that the right of preemption does not apply to certain shared or non-qualifying properties and utilities. It is significant in fiqh discussions of ownership, transfer rights, and the limits of preemption in commercial and property matters.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3374 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) from his forefathers from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"There is no preemption (shufah) in a ship, nor in a river, nor in a road, nor in a mill, nor in a bathhouse."
